answers.core: While most of the use cases are pretty niche, there's a lot of Godot developers interested in retro style graphics. Something like the retro skybox effect ought be convenient and easy to implement.
answers.workaround: You can send camera rotation to a sky shader with a script, but this becomes more complicated for multi-camera setups. It's also possible to create your own skybox object and use the built-ins available to spatial shaders, however sky shaders provide better integration with the environment/reflections system. The additional setup involved in either option makes them inconvenient for sharing shaders.

title: Expose camera forward direction built-in to sky shaders
